_about: Bench fixture (2026-10-01, the concept-layer plan): a pottery studio launching a six-week wheel course. The owner tapped 'World: one offer page' in the Design Coach, so the home stays Signature and the course gets its own World page. Fictional business; nothing here is a real person.
owner_brief: Wheelhouse is a small pottery studio in Pittsburgh with eight wheels. We sell open studio time and pieces, and this fall we are launching a six-week wheel-throwing course on Thursday nights, Sep 4 to Oct 9. Eight seats. Clay, glazes and two firings are included. I want the course to feel like a real term at an art school, with a syllabus and a little ceremony on the last night.
